_comment: The Aqara S1 Plus's budgets (#68). Project choices, not published standards; docs/perf.md, "RAM", and docs/size.md say why and how each is measured. Clarity's report (tools/perf/report.py) reads ram and panes.*.ram_pss_max_kb; CI's size check (tools/size/apksize.py) reads size and panes.*.size_max_bytes, and fails a PR that goes over unless the same PR raises the budget. The pane RAM budgets were set before the first per-pane measurement (2026-11-13); revisit them once one exists. The size budgets are the 2026-11-13 release build as it ships (101.17 MB armeabi-v7a, with the radio bundle as release.yml adds it; 100.78 MB arm64-v8a, without) plus about 2.5%, and each pane's size about twice its own then (at least 100 kB; the radio's includes the bundle, 3.49 MB), so growth is a decision, not a drift. A switchable pane's `switch` is its on/off extra, and `state` how its log shows it running (tools/perf/perflib.py pane_state): Assist by the wake word's microphone, Sendspin by its player, the others by the `Pane <id> on|off` line the kiosk logs at start (`pane:<id>`, #67). Assist is turned off with voice_enabled and its microphone mute (`mute`), because S1 Kiosk 0.4.3 loses a voice_enabled change across its restart (#158, s1v7). `not_switched` says why a pane isn't measured on its own. The 16 MB budgets of the wall base, time zone and diagnostics were set with #67, before they were measured.

radio.not_switched: its on/off is the radio mode, which Clarity leaves as it is so the panel's Zigbee or Thread network stays up
radio.note: its processes run outside the app and are measured in place

timers.not_switched: it comes only with the voice assistant and has no switch of its own, so it is inside assist's share

bluetooth-proxy.not_switched: it scans only while Home Assistant listens, and Clarity's reference run has no Home Assistant listening, so on by itself it would measure an idle pane; measured by hand with HA listening (#121)
bluetooth-proxy.note: 0.02 MB on 2026-11-14 with its engine library

notifications.not_switched: it is off by default and, on, only waits for a notify call; Clarity's pane fixtures (tools/perf, #205) don't switch it yet
